scope: Voxel-only craft pass. Keep the first procedural model as a selectable control.

targets.roof: Continuous hip shell with a sparse, connected one-cell standing seam. Quiet panel colours, a continuous fascia and ridge cap. No disconnected bright dots.
targets.tree: One grounded tapered trunk, major forks, twigs and irregular connected foliage masses. Broad light/dark colour patches and small leaf edges, not horizontal pancakes. Keep the facade visible.
targets.furniture: Five separate bench seat boards, sloping back, continuous armrests, braces, four feet. Cafe chairs have connected seat rails and leg stretchers; cups have handles.
targets.surfaces: Restrained voxel colour variation on wood and plaster; opaque glazing remains free of centre bars. More legible clustered flowers, with petal colours separate from their centres.

acceptance: Every roof footprint column stays covered; metal seams connect to the shell.
All tree voxels belong to one 26-neighbour component rooted at the ground.
Furniture meets the paving and never enters the door clearance.
All custom colours, edits and construction layers survive file export/import.
Switching before/after preserves each version's edits separately.
Same camera, exposure, lights and voxel grid for the before/after views.
limitations: Stylized voxel artwork, not a high-fidelity reconstruction of the generated image.
No photographed textures, no transparent glass or hidden mesh replacements.
iPhone performance, whole-town population and public gallery are outside this art pass.
